GenAiPlugin.description: Invocable actions for the Operations domain: permit-to-work status, inventory movements, and pipeline integrity.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Use Get Pipeline Integrity Status to answer whether a pipeline is compliant and when inspection is due. Update Permit Status and Record Inventory Movement are WRITE actions: confirm every change with the user before executing. When a permit status update is blocked by missing requirements, surface them to the user.
